parks.name: Point Reyes National Seashore
parks.blurb: Tule elk, seals, bobcats and huge flocks of shorebirds on wild coastal bluffs.

parks.name: Marin Headlands
parks.blurb: Hawk Hill's fall raptor migration, coyotes and harbor seals right by the Golden Gate.

parks.name: Muir Woods & Mount Tamalpais
parks.blurb: Old-growth redwoods with banana slugs, newts and Steller's jays.

parks.name: Golden Gate Park & Presidio
parks.blurb: City nature: coyotes, hawks, hummingbirds and herons without leaving San Francisco.

parks.name: Mount Diablo State Park
parks.blurb: Oak woodland and chaparral full of lizards, raptors, tarantulas and acorn woodpeckers.

parks.name: Big Basin Redwoods
parks.blurb: California's oldest state park, with redwoods, salamanders and banana slugs.

parks.name: Elkhorn Slough & Moss Landing
parks.blurb: Sea otters, harbor seals, pelicans and herons in a calm coastal estuary.

parks.name: Monterey & Point Lobos
parks.blurb: Tide pools, kelp forests, sea otters and sea lions along a rocky coast.

parks.name: Pinnacles National Park
parks.blurb: Volcanic spires where California condors soar, plus bats, lizards and raptors.

parks.name: Big Sur Coast
parks.blurb: Condors, whales and sea otters along one of the world's most dramatic coastlines.

parks.name: Yosemite Valley
parks.blurb: Black bears, mule deer, Steller's jays and western gray squirrels under granite cliffs.

parks.name: Tuolumne Meadows & Tioga Pass
parks.blurb: High Sierra meadows with marmots, pikas and Belding's ground squirrels.

parks.name: Sequoia National Park
parks.blurb: Giant sequoias, black bears and mountain wildlife.

parks.name: Lake Tahoe (California shore)
parks.blurb: Alpine lake with ospreys, bald eagles, bears and Steller's jays.

parks.name: Prairie Creek Redwoods
parks.blurb: Roosevelt elk grazing in meadows beside towering redwoods.

parks.name: Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Winter home of huge flocks of geese, ducks, egrets and bald eagles.

parks.name: Carrizo Plain National Monument
parks.blurb: Wide-open grassland with pronghorn, kestrels, golden eagles and spring wildflowers.

parks.name: Santa Monica Mountains
parks.blurb: Chaparral canyons with bobcats, rattlesnakes, newts and roadrunners near Los Angeles.

parks.name: Griffith Park
parks.blurb: LA's big urban park, home to coyotes, hawks, lizards and the famous mountain lion P-22.

parks.name: Bolsa Chica Ecological Reserve
parks.blurb: Southern California wetland packed with herons, egrets, pelicans and shorebirds.

parks.name: La Jolla Cove & Torrey Pines
parks.blurb: Sea lions, seals, garibaldi and leopard sharks, plus coastal sage scrub trails.

parks.name: Anza-Borrego Desert State Park
parks.blurb: Bighorn sheep, roadrunners, desert iguanas and spring wildflower blooms.

parks.name: Joshua Tree National Park
parks.blurb: Desert lizards, jackrabbits, roadrunners and ravens among Joshua trees.

parks.name: Mono Lake
parks.blurb: Salty lake with tufa towers, gulls, and sagebrush wildlife on the Sierra's east side.
